provenance: LLM-proposed from KMeans clusters of real DEV-split customer messages. Human-reviewable; NOT hand-crafted. Discovered on DEV only — gold_pool was never read (leakage path L5).

intents.name: content_availability
intents.definition: Requests or complaints regarding missing seasons, episodes, movies, or networks on Hulu.
intents.includes: Messages asking when a specific season/episode will be on Hulu, or complaining that a show/network is missing.
intents.excludes: Issues with technical playback errors or missing episodes due to a watchlist/app bug.
example_messages: When will season 3 be available on Hulu ??
Why isn’t season 18 on Netflix or Hulu

intents.name: account_and_billing_management
intents.definition: Inquiries or issues related to Hulu account settings, membership plans, subscriptions, and billing charges.
intents.includes: Questions about account sharing, unexpected charges, signing up, canceling, or changing subscription plans.
intents.excludes: General app navigation complaints or streaming quality issues not directly related to billing.
example_messages: Can you help me with a strange charge on my bank account from Hulu?
How do I cancel crappy Hulu???

intents.name: live_tv_streaming
intents.definition: Questions, feature requests, or technical issues specifically concerning Hulu + Live TV and local channels/sports.
intents.includes: Issues streaming live TV, local affiliate outages, channel guide complaints, and requests for specific live channels.
intents.excludes: General on-demand video streaming issues or non-live app bugs.
example_messages: Hey why can't I stream live from my laptop anymore? For the past two days I get error playlist-1-FDC2F871.
When will NBC live be available?

intents.name: commercials_and_ads
intents.definition: Complaints regarding ad repetition, ad volume, freezing caused by ads, or seeing ads on commercial-free plans.
intents.includes: Complaints about repetitive commercials, loud ad volumes, ad-induced crashes, and getting ads despite paying for no-commercials.
intents.excludes: General video buffering or playback errors unrelated to ad breaks.
example_messages: Why doesn’t Hulu ever have any variety to their commercials. I’ve seen the same Biz Markie Gap commercial like 1 million times.
I pay for Hulu with no ads and I’m deadass watching an ad right now.

intents.name: technical_support_and_errors
intents.definition: Reports of error codes, app crashes, buffering, streaming failures, and troubleshooting steps tried by the user.
intents.includes: Error codes (e.g., error 400, teal-8, 404), app freezing, casting failures, and device compatibility issues.
intents.excludes: Feature requests, content availability questions, and billing issues.
example_messages: I’m still getting the same error code 400 I reset my internet and all
My Hulu is not working. Worked last night. Other apps on my tv are fine.

intents.name: app_interface_and_ux
intents.definition: Feedback, complaints, or questions regarding the Hulu app interface, navigation, updates, and user experience.
intents.includes: Complaints about the new interface, Roku/Apple TV app navigation, missing features like skip intro or download options, and UI layout changes.
intents.excludes: Technical playback error codes or streaming downtime.
example_messages: I've been using the Hulu app on Roku for over a month now and I still hate the new interface.
Your app on Apple TV is the worst UX ever.

intents.name: watchlist_and_playback_tracking
intents.definition: Issues where watchlists, history, new episode indicators, or autoplay fail to track correctly.
intents.includes: Watchlist not updating, episodes marked incorrectly as new, episodes restarting from the beginning, or autoplay failing to advance.
intents.excludes: Content completely missing from the platform library.
example_messages: why is my watchlist not updating with new episodes?
It’s not showing when there are new episodes and when you watch a new episode it continues to say it’s a new episode
